menu_options.meters: Link meters (heat pump, EV charger, solar)

loads.title: Report runs
loads.description: Pick a smart device from the app to link the entities that tell the integration when it ran and what it used. Choose Done to save.

load.title: {load}
load.description: Running entity: a switch, binary sensor or status sensor that is on/run while {load} runs. Energy entity: a kWh total or a power in W (a smart plug, for instance). Without a running entity, power above the threshold means running. Leave both empty to unlink the device.

meters.title: Report meters
meters.description: Pick for each meter a sensor that counts total energy in kWh (a rising counter, not power). The reading is sent to the app every five minutes; the planner uses it to forecast your consumption. Link the EV charger only if its consumption is part of the house consumption in the app, and solar only if the app does not show those panels yet. Clearing a field unlinks the meter.

data.solar: Solar panels the installation does not measure

error.kwh_needs_running: A kWh total does not tell when the device runs: add a running entity, or use a power sensor (W).
error.meter_needs_kwh: Pick a sensor with an energy counter in kWh (not power in W).

abort.no_smart_loads: No smart devices yet: switch them on in the app under Account > Slimme apparaten first (the integration sees it within five minutes).

meld_apparaat.name: Report run
meld_apparaat.description: Tells Mijn SlimStroom that a smart device ran, for your own automations without the link in the options.

load_id.name: Device id
load_id.description: The device id as in the app (for example boiler).

ended_at.name: Ended at
ended_at.description: End of the run; empty = still running.

kwh.name: Energy (kWh)
kwh.description: Measured energy of this run; empty = estimate from the settings.
